headline: Yandex Cloud says drone strikes on datacenters caused data loss
summary: Yandex Cloud said drone attacks on its datacenters caused data loss, with one report putting the loss at nearly 3% of its data. The company said it had restored access to more than 97% of customer data, and has now switched to enabling backups by default.
